{{Top|leg}}
{{Otheruses|Sith|more=sorcerer}}
{{Quote|Weakling! You will never reach your potential if you falter at the slightest obstacle. Beyond that wall lies your destiny. Beyond that wall lies the full power of the dark side. If you do not have the strength to reach it, then you do not deserve to become a Sith sorcerer!|The spirit of [[Freedon Nadd]]|<ref name="totjc">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Naga_Sadow_WotC.jpg|thumb|220px|Naga Sadow, powerful Sith sorcerer and Dark Lord of the Sith]]

A '''Sith sorcerer''' or '''sorceress''', also known archaically as a '''Sith Mage''' or '''Sith Magician''', was an individual who was proficient in the arts of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]], using spells, talismans, or incantations to focus the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. They were discovered during the time of the original [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. Sith sorcerers gained their powers through intense study of Sith traditions, and applications of the dark side of Force. Occasionally, an aspiring sorcerer's powers were developed through sheer innate talent, rather than harnessing them through study, spontaneously, or being bestowed upon them by another source.

Sith sorcerers were not always [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]]. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] and [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] were both Sith sorcerers, having been apprenticed to [[Freedon Nadd]], but neither one attained the title of Sith Lord. On the other hand, [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], Freedon Nadd, [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] and [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] all were Sith sorcerers and Sith Lords simultaneously.

The term was also used for [[Sith Inquisitor]]s who fought for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed it circa [[3653 BBY]]. These [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] specialized in ranged attack abilities with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], such as [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and [[Force drain/Legends|Force drain]]. Sith Sorcerers were known to primarily wield one lightsaber in combat, and were adept at [[Force lightning/Legends#Variants_of_Force_lightning|variant applications]] of Force lightning in combat.

==History==
{{Quote|The Sith have existed for well over a hundred thousand years. Over that barely imaginable space of time many Sith magicians emerged with the might of the dark side grasped firmly in their hands&hellip;|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ood Bnar]]|<ref name="totjc" />}}
[[File:Aleemaspet.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Sith sorceress Aleema Keto terrorizes her subordinates with her [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|realistic illusions]].]]
Sith sorcerers were already of notable importance in the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith society]] before the [[Exiles|Dark Jedi Exiles]] arrived on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. In her personal journal, [[Sorzus Syn]] praised the efficiency of Sith incantations. She also noted that, in battle, [[Sith King]]s used to remove their best sorcerers from the melee and put them on high parapets. From higher grounds, the magicians would rain their curses upon the armies below.<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

Sith sorcerers were prevalent during the time of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. One of the most famous sorcerers was the<ref name="dark1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]]</ref> [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="golden4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]].<ref name="dark1" /> Sadow initiated at least one known apprentice in the ways of Sith sorcery, a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] named [[Gav Daragon]].<ref name="golden4" /> However, Gav did not complete his apprenticeship, and so never fully attained the full abilities of a Sith sorcerer.<ref name="fall4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 4]]</ref>

Nearly six hundred years later, Naga Sadow would find another in which to initiate the Sith teachings, a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] by the name of [[Freedon Nadd]]. Nadd took what he learned from Naga Sadow and with it conquered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], infusing the planet with the dark side of the Force. After his death, Freedon Nadd's own descendants ruled Onderon in the centuries thereafter, also practicing Sith sorcery and using it to maintain their rule over the planet.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

Four hundred years after Nadd's death, when Onderon was finally liberated of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] during the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]], two young socialites, [[Aleema Keto]] and her cousin [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal]], escaped Onderon with Sith knowledge learned from King [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]]. Freedon Nadd's spirit also happened upon them on Onderon, and began to instruct the Ketos further in the Sith arts.<ref name="nadd2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]</ref>

Aleema and Satal were successful in their quest for dark side power. Now calling themselves the Krath, they used their new abilities to stage a [[Political uprising of the Empress Teta system|takeover]] of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]].<ref name="dark1" /> Meanwhile, Freedon Nadd's spirit located another powerful Jedi with a hunger for the dark side named [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], and taught him extensively in the ways of harnessing Sith sorcery. Afterwards, the Krath sorcerers waged war on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the Jedi in what was known as the [[Krath Holy Crusade]]. The crusade spurred a series of events which included the defection of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] to the Krath,<ref name="DLOTS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith]]''</ref> the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Satal Keto,<ref name="dark5">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 5]]</ref> and ended with the emergence of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. Kun and Qel-Droma then combined forces<ref name="dark6">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 6]]</ref> and waged the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] against the Republic.<ref name="TSW">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]''</ref> The Jedi were able to finally defeat the Sith, in the climactic [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|Battle of Yavin 4]].<ref name="TSW6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref>

During the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Sith sorcerers were employed by the returned [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="FanFriday">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100820-0|text=STAR WARS: The Old Republic Fan Friday (August 20, 2010)|nolive=1}}</ref> These sorcerers were specialized [[Sith Inquisitor]]s.<ref name="Holonet-Sith Inquisitor">{{Holonet|classes|sith-inquisitor|Sith Inquisitor}}</ref>

Millennia later, Sith sorcery would resurface in the form of the young Sith apprentice [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]. After transcribing the ancient Sith spells locked within [[Freedon Nadd's holocron]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] presented his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] Zannah with them, stating that her talents in the Force lie in the intricacies of Sith sorcery. Being an insatiable learner, Zannah engrossed herself in Nadd's teachings. As she progressed, her ability to perform her spells became considerable, at times using simple thoughts or complex hand gestures with minimal effort. Darth Bane encouraged his pupil to study Sith sorcery for it was a naturally strong skill for her. He himself had little affinity for it, only ever bothering to try to use a couple of these esoteric thaumaturgies.<ref name="ROT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith sorcerer is an advanced class for the Sith Inquisitor class in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMO video game. This advanced class specializes in the use of a single lightsaber and Force lightning in combat, as well as Force drain and [[Force healing/Legends|Force healing]]. The Republic counterpart for this archetype is the [[Jedi Sage]].<ref name="FanFriday" />
